##### Project general facts

Samana Waves Phase II is a complex of ultra-high-end residential apartments by the award-winning Samana Developers. Designed for those who prefer leisure, lavishness, and a bit of extravagance in life, this luxurious development offers state-of-the-art apartments with spacious interiors and breathtaking views. Featuring select private pools inside apartments, a leisure deck with a gigantic pool, iconic cascading water features, indoor and outdoor gyms, sauna and steam room, and a dedicated kids' play area, Samana Waves Phase II offers all amenities one could wish for a truly luxurious lifestyle.

Residents enjoy a wealth of premium amenities including a luxurious and large leisure pool deck, a main pool accompanied by water features, a spacious kids' play area, private pools inside select apartments, a full health club, indoor and outdoor gyms, a sauna and steam room, a jacuzzi, and valet parking. The development exudes elegance throughout its structure and style, with a luxury ambience embodying a smart lifestyle, a grand lobby, and panoramic elevators that create an impression of grandeur and extravagance.

Every residence at Samana Waves Phase II features duplex-style living with spacious interiors and modern design. The apartments are crafted with high-quality finishes and contemporary aesthetics, creating bright, inviting spaces that feel both luxurious and comfortable. The thoughtful layouts maximize both space and natural light, while the private pools in select apartments offer an added touch of exclusivity and resort-style living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, just next to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and near Dubai International Stadium, this exceptional location offers residents easy access to everything needed for everyday life. The community is strategically positioned near key destinations including Dubai Miracle Garden, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to a wealth of amenities, including schools, medical facilities, convenience stores, shopping centres, and golf courses. The area offers direct access to the main highway, ensuring seamless connectivity to all parts of the city. Whether for work, leisure, or family life, every essential is within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
